about: Receiving-water names in SD's reports (EPA's overflow tables for South Dakota permits, the extract of 2026-11-04, and DANR's harmful algal bloom advisories, read 2026-11-07) that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for SD, by name as typed, with the number of reports giving each. Reports that say the discharge reached no water are left out.
